mechanism: Citalopram (SSRI) increases bleeding risk and may cause hyponatremia; zoledronic acid causes electrolyte abnormalities and shares potential for QT prolongation at higher citalopram doses.
action: Monitor for hyponatremia, bleeding signs, and electrolytes; use citalopram at doses ≤20 mg/day due to QT prolongation risk; ensure adequate renal function monitoring given zoledronic acid nephrotoxicity.
